description: Create useNotificationAlerts hook, add message alert icon + general alerts icon to PublicDashboardHeader, and add ProfileDialog with avatar upload, display name and sound toggle.
steps: Step 1 — Create src/hooks/useNotificationAlerts.ts. Export interfaces NotificationAlert { id, conversationId, contactName, preview, timestamp, read } and AppAlert { id, title, message, timestamp, read }. Export useNotificationAlerts({ conversationIds: string[], clientId: string | null }) that: reads soundEnabled from localStorage('notification_sound_enabled') (default true); subscribes to Supabase Realtime postgres_changes INSERT on client_channel_messages filtered by conversation_id=in.(ids) only when conversationIds.length > 0; re-subscribes when JSON.stringify(conversationIds) changes; on INSERT of direction='inbound' builds NotificationAlert, prepends to alerts (max 50), increments unreadAlerts, plays 440Hz/200ms AudioContext tone when soundEnabled; returns { alerts, unreadAlerts, clearAlerts, markAllRead, soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled }. setSoundEnabled persists to localStorage.

Step 2 — Add alert icons to src/pages/public-dashboard/PublicDashboardHeader.tsx. Add useEffect, useState, useRef to React imports. Add local state: myAgentId (string|null), agentConvIds (string[]). Add useEffect that when auth?.user?.id && auth?.id are truthy: calls supabase.rpc('ensure_client_agent', { p_client_id, p_organization_id, p_crm_user_id, p_display_name, p_avatar_url }) using same pattern as OmnichannelInboxPage to extract agent_id into myAgentId; then queries SELECT id FROM client_channel_conversations WHERE assigned_agent_id=myAgentId AND status='human_active' AND client_id=auth.id and sets agentConvIds. Call useNotificationAlerts({ conversationIds: agentConvIds, clientId: auth?.id ?? null }) (import from @/hooks/useNotificationAlerts). Import Bell from lucide-react and Popover/PopoverContent/PopoverTrigger from @/components/ui/popover. Add import { format, parseISO } from 'date-fns' for timestamp formatting.

Step 3 — Render two icon buttons in the header before the profile DropdownMenu. First: Popover-wrapped Bell button showing red badge with unreadAlerts when > 0; popover lists latest 10 alerts (contactName + truncated preview + formatted timestamp); footer 'Limpar' button calls clearAlerts(). Second: plain Bell button with title='Alertas da aplicação' and no badge (prepared for future AppAlerts).

Step 4 — Add ProfileDialog component in src/pages/public-dashboard/PublicDashboardHeader.tsx. Props: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void }. Internal state: displayName (pre-filled from auth?.user?.full_name ?? auth?.name ?? ''), avatarUrl (from auth?.user?.avatar_url ?? localStorage user_avatar_url_${userId}), soundEnabled (from localStorage), saving. File input (hidden, accept image/*) triggers Supabase storage upload to avatars bucket path client-avatars/${clientId}/${userId} with upsert:true; on success sets avatarUrl + saves to localStorage; on error falls back to blob URL in localStorage. Save button: tries supabase.from('client_users').update({ full_name }).eq('id', userId), on error tries supabase.from('crm_users').update({ full_name }).eq('id', userId), on second error stores in localStorage; always stores soundEnabled to localStorage. Render: avatar img (or initials fallback), 'Alterar foto' button, Nome de exibição input, Alerta sonoro toggle (checkbox or Switch), Salvar button.

Step 5 — Wire ProfileDialog into the header. Add avatarPreview local state initialized from localStorage.getItem('user_avatar_url_${auth?.user?.id}') (guarded by userId). Update the avatar trigger button to show img if avatarPreview, else initials. Add showProfileDialog state. In DropdownMenu replace the info-only profile item with an 'Editar Perfil' item that sets showProfileDialog=true. Render <ProfileDialog open={showProfileDialog} onOpenChange={setShowProfileDialog} /> in the header JSX.

ProfileDialog has display name input (pre-filled), avatar upload, sound toggle, save button
